profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lila Sciences
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer in Test with 7+ years architecting scalable test automation frameworks across robotics, embedded hardware, and enterprise software. Currently building greenfield test automation for Amazon's Seraph camera system, integrating hardware-in-the-loop validation with Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.

My career began with three early-career QA roles in California (2018–2019), including a contract position at Location Labs, followed by a move to Boston and progressive senior automation roles at CSPi, Walmart, Doble Engineering, and now Amazon Robotics.

Specializations:
• Test framework architecture in Python and Java (Playwright, Selenium, pywinauto)
• CI/CD pipeline design with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS (EC2, EKS, S3)
• Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing for embedded systems and robotics• Leading framework migrations and mentoring engineers through technical transitions

Recent highlights from my time at Doble Engineering: led migration of a legacy UFT framework to Python (pywinauto), delivering 2x faster startup orchestration; architected end-to-end Jenkins/AWS EC2 CI/CD pipeline serving as the quality gate for all software releases; standardized Playwright automation frameworks (Python for web UI, Java for desktop applications), reducing execution time by 2x.

Open to senior SDET and test automation architect roles. Best reached at davidlee.2018.ucb@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Test Robotics
positions.locationName: North Reading, Massachusetts, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Working on test and validation infrastructure for Seraph, a robotic perception system combining RGB imaging and indirect Time-of-Flight (iToF) depth sensing. My work spans Python automation, embedded Linux, firmware, camera hardware, image-quality analysis, and hardware-in-the-loop validation, with a focus on building reliable systems for testing the boundary between software and physical hardware.

• Architected Python-based HIL automation across embedded compute modules, REST interfaces, firmware, calibration workflows, and physical camera hardware.
• Developed automated RGB and iToF image-quality validation covering depth accuracy, temporal noise, confidence coverage, frame stability, CIE ΔE color accuracy, slanted-edge MTF, ArUco detection, barcode recognition, and OCR.
• Built reusable camera-analysis and capture utilities for multi-frame depth, confidence, and intensity data, reducing previously manual, full-day validation workflows to repeatable test runs completed in ~1 hour.
• Automated camera stream-metrics validation across free-running and externally triggered modes, using I²C fault injection to verify lifecycle events, frame-count consistency, error histograms, measured frame rates, timeout handling, and stream-UUID integrity.
• Expanded an embedded robotics regression suite with 15+ automated scenarios spanning image quality, camera configuration, stream reliability, OTA updates, error recovery, and multiple camera/hardware variants.
• Led system-level debugging across cameras, FPGAs, firmware, Linux drivers, embedded compute modules, and test infrastructure, uncovering race conditions, depth-data parsing issues, post-reboot camera-readiness failures, and driver-configuration defects.
• Strengthened automation reliability through unit testing, log-driven failure analysis, static analysis, and code reviews, achieving 100% coverage on several modified stream-metrics components.

positions.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
• Joined Doble as a Senior QA Engineer to modernize automation across multiple products, replacing legacy tooling and establishing scalable test frameworks.
• Led migration of Protection Suite automation from UFT to Python/pytest using pywinauto and Windows UI Automation, building reusable abstractions for application control, state detection, and failure handling while mentoring the team through the transition.
• Built hardware-in-the-loop reliability automation coordinating Protection Suite with F8 test equipment, programmatically power-cycling hardware through a network PDU and validating recovery across repeated test cycles.
• Developed resilient long-running test infrastructure with asynchronous dialog monitoring, automated recovery from firmware and communication errors, and failure screenshot capture.
• Integrated automated testing into Jenkins on dedicated Windows test agents, executing smoke tests and building TestRail API integration for traceable test execution and reporting.
• Standardized Playwright frameworks in Python and Java across web applications, establishing reusable patterns that reduced execution time by 2x.
• Improved regression and smoke test reporting by modularizing results by test suite, making failures easier to isolate during release validation.
• Established required code reviews and diagnosed flaky tests and complex defects across automation and application codebases.
• Served as Scrum Master for the QA team, facilitating standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Joined Walmart to lead automation for the warehouse robotics console emulation tool, expanding into BDD-driven testing of large-scale robotics systems.
• Developed Python/Selenium test automation using page object models and BDD (Gherkin) to align testing with product requirements for warehouse robotics systems.
• Served as lead automation engineer for the Dispense by Temperature Zone feature, owning test strategy and implementation end-to-end.
• Improved Python automation performance for decant and dispense features, reducing execution times by 10%.
• Championed integration of TestRail with Jira/Xray, creating data-driven reporting workflows that empowered leadership to make informed release decisions.

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
• Joined CSPi to build out automation foundations for their newly launched Aria Zero Trust Center product, owning automation tooling and process from the ground up.
• Owned Python/Selenium automation for the Aria Zero Trust Center UI, developing functional tests and integrating them into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
• Introduced and integrated the Xray test suite within Jira for test case management and run tracking, establishing a scalable process for the team.
• Implemented a Bash dependency-verification script for Jenkins-managed VMs, eliminating environment-related pipeline failures.

projects.title: Google Search Radar
projects.description:
- Architected a production-grade test suite for a Chrome extension, utilizing Playwright for E2E
UI flows and Jest for unit testing.
- Engineered a Docker-based workflow for consistent test execution across local and CI
environments (GitLab CI/GitHub Actions), eliminating environment-related failures.
- Implemented JSON schema validation in API tests to ensure data structure integrity between
the extension and backend services.

projects.title: k8s-test-runner
projects.description: A little platform for running Playwright tests in parallel on Kubernetes. Each pod takes a shard, dumps its results to S3, and an aggregator pulls everything back into one report. Built to learn the K8s + AWS patterns properly — works locally on Kind, designed for EKS, runs in a Codespace so anyone can clone and try it.
